# netcup_dns_record (Resource)

A single DNS record within a netcup-hosted zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_dns_record" "www" {
  domain      = "example.com"
  hostname    = "www"
  type        = "A"
  destination = "203.0.113.10"
}

resource "netcup_dns_record" "mx" {
  domain      = "example.com"
  hostname    = "@"
  type        = "MX"
  priority    = "10"
  destination = "mail.example.com"
}

resource "netcup_dns_record" "spf" {
  domain      = "example.com"
  hostname    = "@"
  type        = "TXT"
  destination = "v=spf1 -all"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) Record value (target / content).
- `domain` (String) Zone (domain) the record belongs to, e.g. `example.com`.
- `hostname` (String) Record host, e.g. `@`, `www` or `_dmarc`.
- `type` (String) Record type, e.g. `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`.

### Optional

- `priority` (String) Priority, relevant for `MX` / `SRV`. Defaults to `0`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) netcup record id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import format: <domain>:<record_id>
terraform import netcup_dns_record.www example.com:123456789
```
